key.name: wallpaper-root
key.summary: Root directory holding the weather-bucket subfolders
key.description: Empty string means the default ($HOME/Pictures/Weather-Wallpapers). Subfolders expected: clear, clouds, rain, storm, snow, fog, night, default.

key.name: rotation-interval-minutes
key.summary: How often (minutes) to advance to the next wallpaper

key.name: rotation-enabled
key.summary: Automatically rotate wallpaper on the configured interval

key.name: weather-enabled
key.summary: Choose the wallpaper bucket from current weather instead of cycling all buckets

key.name: weather-refresh-minutes
key.summary: How often (minutes) to refresh the weather lookup

key.name: location-source
key.summary: How to determine the user location for the weather lookup

key.name: manual-latitude
key.summary: Latitude used when location-source = manual

key.name: manual-longitude
key.summary: Longitude used when location-source = manual

key.name: accent-follow-enabled
key.summary: Set the GNOME accent colour from the active wallpaper

key.name: color-scheme-follow-enabled
key.summary: Switch GNOME color-scheme (light/dark) based on wallpaper luminance

key.name: current-bucket
key.summary: The most recently selected weather bucket (runtime state)

key.name: current-index
key.summary: Index of the current wallpaper within the active bucket (runtime state)

key.name: current-time-bucket
key.summary: The most recently computed time-of-day bucket (morning/afternoon/evening/night) — empty disables time-of-day layering

key.name: time-of-day-enabled
key.summary: Layer wallpaper selection by time of day (morning/afternoon/evening/night) under the weather bucket

key.name: last-resolved-latitude
key.summary: Latitude resolved by the last successful IP lookup (display only)

key.name: last-resolved-longitude
key.summary: Longitude resolved by the last successful IP lookup (display only)

key.name: last-resolved-city
key.summary: City reported by the last successful IP lookup (display only)

key.name: last-resolved-region
key.summary: Region/state reported by the last successful IP lookup (display only)

key.name: last-resolved-country
key.summary: Country reported by the last successful IP lookup (display only)

key.name: last-rotation-timestamp
key.summary: Unix epoch seconds of the most recent automatic rotation (display only)

key.name: widgets-enabled
key.summary: Master switch for the desktop widget subsystem

key.name: widget-instances
key.summary: JSON-encoded array of widget instance records
key.description: Each entry: {instanceId, uuid, monitor, x, y, config}. Written by the running extension; safe to edit manually but malformed JSON resets to an empty list.
